QuestInfo.name: [Papulatus] The Light Of Chaos
QuestInfo.0: Ask about the mystical thing #p2041021# says he saw. \r\n
QuestInfo.1: #p2041021# says he saw a huge light fall and land at the Clocktower Bottom Floor, then disappear into the Crack in Time. #p2041021# wants you to look into anything that might provide some insight on what that light was.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You were looking into the light that fell into the Crack in Time, when #p2041026# said that the spirit detector was going wild. \r\n
QuestInfo.summary: Meet #eGhosthunter Bob#n in #m220050300##k and find clues about the Light of Chaos.

1.0: This is all so strange. What is going on?

yes.0: Just look at my spirit detector... It's going crazy! The ghost detection rate at the Clocktower Bottom Floor is off the charts!

default.0: The light at the Crack in Time... It's disappeared! You HAVE to investigate it, you simply must!
